item.title: Saweetie & Jason Derulo Sued for Backing Out of Japan’s Afro Jam Fest — But Still Keeping Advances
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest entertainment update. Today, we're talking about two big names in music: Saweetie and Jason Derulo. Both artists are facing lawsuits over canceled performances at Japan's Afro Jam Festival last summer.
[Short music transition]
Host: According to court documents, Japanese concert promoters Moon Dream Production Co. and SFL Group are suing Saweetie and Jason Derulo for millions of dollars in damages. The lawsuits allege that both artists breached their contracts to perform at the festival.
[Short music transition]
Host: In Jason Derulo's case, he was paid a $200,000 advance to perform in Okinawa and Osaka, but it was later discovered that he was already booked to perform in Spain during the same time. Despite being asked to refund the deposit, Derulo has refused.
[Short music transition]
Host: Saweetie is facing similar allegations. She received a $100,000 advance to perform across multiple cities, but failed to fulfill her promise. What's more, she allegedly used the promoters' services to get a visa and performed at unaffiliated nightclubs instead of the scheduled venues.
[Short music transition]
Host: The promoters are now demanding that both artists repay their advances, plus $300,000 each for non-refundable expenses, and millions of dollars in punitive damages. Representatives for Derulo and Saweetie have not commented on the lawsuits.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's the latest from the world of entertainment. We'll be keeping an eye on this story and bringing you updates as more information becomes available. Thanks for tuning in!
